notes: Protocol unit tests do not establish full runtime acceptance.
Inherited status is a verbatim snapshot, not a new V7 test result.
Unsupported, deferred, not_run and insufficient_data are never passes.
B3 passes are bounded to explicitly host-enabled current full templates; no delta, model, historical page or production quality acceptance is inferred.
